text.p: Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT), Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) and Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) said they will be closed July 4 to observe U.S. Independence Day.
CBOT said that on July 3, financial and insurance contracts will close at 1210 CDT/1710 GMT but all agricultural and metals contracts will observe normal schedules.
Project A and the CBOT evening pit sessions will be closed.
On July 6, the CBOT evening pit session and overnight Project A trading will be open.
For CME, on July 3 interest-rate and currency products will close early at 1200 CDT, equity and GSCI products will shut early at 1215 and agricultural contracts will close early at 1300.
A GLOBEX session will start at 1430 July 3 and end at 1030 July 4. GLOBEX will open at 1730 July 6 and close at its regularly scheduled time on July 7.

CBOE said interest rate options will close at 1200 on July 3, equity options and sector index options will end at 1202 and broad-based index options and international index options will close at 1215.
